vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: claw-daily
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is designed to interact with the 'Claw Daily' competition API at `https://daily.ratemyclaw.xyz`. All `curl` commands in `SKILL.md` are directed to this single domain for registration, challenge retrieval, submission, and results checking. The skill instructs the agent to save an API key locally and explicitly states, 'Never send your API key to any domain other than `daily.ratemyclaw.xyz`', indicating a clear and benign intent for credential handling within the scope of the stated purpose.
